prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready pixel art inventory sprite sheet for the cozy Flower Valley game. Create ONE landscape PNG sprite atlas, aspect ratio 3:2, with a genuinely transparent alpha background. Exactly 5 separate item icons in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid of equal square cells. First 3 items in the top row, next 2 in bottom-left and bottom-center. Bottom-right cell completely empty and transparent. Each icon centered in its own cell, full silhouette contained within central 72% of cell, generous padding, no overlap. Consistent charming detailed 32-bit pixel art with crisp square pixels, dark muted outlines, warm natural colors, upper-left highlights, no blur, no gradients, no cast shadow beyond silhouette. NO text, NO numbers, NO price labels, NO grid lines, NO borders, NO checkerboard background. These images will be cropped by exact equal grid coordinates inside the real game. Subjects in exact reading order: 1 white-petal Daisy with golden center and green stem/leaves; 2 pink Tulip with green stem/leaves; 3 yellow Sunflower with brown center and green stem/leaves; 4 red-pink Rose with green stem/leaves; 5 purple Lavender sprig with green stem/leaves. Exactly one botanical item per cell. Flowers visibly distinct, approximately equal visual weight.
